items.reason: The head is now rendered into the same HTML.Context as the body (bytes reset, indentation set), so head styles join the one style registry and counter: they appear in the <style> element and cannot reuse a body class name (the old separate head context restarted the counter at 0, so its class names collided with the body's). Test in HTML.Document.Protocol Tests.swift: a red body div and a blue head title both appear, as color-0 and color-1.

notes: Body is still rendered before the head, so body classes are numbered first.
